description: This Java interface defines a client for accessing Hono's Tenant API, including methods for retrieving tenant information via tenant ID or subject DN, with support for tracing context.

classes.name: TenantClient
classes.description: Interface for a client to access Hono's Tenant API, providing methods to retrieve tenant information based on tenant ID or subject DN, with optional tracing context.

methods.name: get
methods.description: Retrieves tenant information for a given tenant ID, returning a Future with TenantObject.

methods.name: get
methods.description: Default method that retrieves tenant information for a given tenant ID with tracing context, delegating to the primary get method.

methods.name: get
methods.description: Retrieves tenant information based on the subject DN of a trusted certificate authority, returning a Future with TenantObject.

methods.name: get
methods.description: Default method that retrieves tenant information for a given subject DN with tracing context, delegating to the primary get method.
